provenance.note: Normalised gain = per-bucket loss improvement / its mean over the 8 buckets, averaged over contrasts; sem = standard error over contrasts. The long/short ratio is computed in the page as mean(shape[512..4096]) / mean(shape[32..256]), which reproduces the paper text (1.52, 0.98, 0.88). Two SMELT contrasts (1.6B, E/s = 24 and 42) fall below the 2 mnat shape floor and are excluded upstream.
